notes.title: Thank You!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087239/45feb0a3491e8e31e36bb6ea273c0a5c00004822.png"][/img][b]Hey Everyone![/b]

We’re thrilled to share some incredible news: Vextorial just became the most-awarded game at the very first Dark Horse Indie Game Awards, taking home 6 awards in total!

This recognition means so much to us as a small indie team. From the very start, our goal has been to create something truly unique: a puzzle adventure that bends dimensions, challenges perspective, and stays with you long after you put down the controller

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087239/301f1d5866cbdc6a6c862183baab2f99f331a42d.png"][/img]

Every award is a reminder that the hard work, late nights, and passion we’ve poured into Vextorial is resonating with players, and we couldn’t be more grateful.

With launch just weeks away, we can’t wait for you to experience the gravity flips, perspective shifts, and mysteries of The Bridge for yourself.

-Dink

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087239/b53f5aab401aa6790e774413a695f25d5362bff3.gif"][/img]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087239/884c324e9d938387f3c0b59376d5dd68bcfa28c2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Final Flip – Launch Date Locked!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey there![/b]    It’s official, Vextorial launches in just 4 weeks!  This isn’t just another puzzle game. In Vextorial, you’ll:[/p][p]🔹 Shift between 2D and 3D perspectives to uncover paths hidden in plain sight[/p][p]🔹 Bend gravity itself to forge impossible routes through ancient ruins[/p][p]🔹 Unravel a surreal mystery about memory, identity, and a brother you never had

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087239/5812da72e7fe0c9104dc6f2d25b85e5b5d260f9d.gif"][/img][/p][p]Players and press who’ve tried it have already called it “mind-bending” and “unlike anything else.” With awards under its belt and glowing early reviews, Vextorial is shaping up to be one of the most unique puzzle adventures of the year.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087239/a0058f9809b3093ccd5da3137ec496c2e6839ee2.gif"][/img]If you love games that challenge the way you think about space and perspective, this is one you won’t want to miss.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087239/b53f5aab401aa6790e774413a695f25d5362bff3.gif"][/img][/p][p]👉 Wishlist Vextorial now to be notified the moment it launches and join us when reality flips.  In a game about changing perspectives, discover people’s perspectives on change.  

See you in The Bridge  
- DInk [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087239/2e37934be97ff3aceb2452b8ea70b93471ad1d79.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Big News: VEXT Games + Dink Team Up!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey everyone,[/b][/p][p]We’re now just under 2 months away from the launch of Vextorial, and we’re thrilled to share some exciting news: we’ve partnered with the amazing team over at Dink to help us bring the game over the finish line!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087239/bcc3c2d5a33360ec441b8421917654d9e8b27344.png"][/img][/p][p]This partnership means we’ll have extra support as we polish the game, fine-tune the experience, and make sure Vextorial is the best it can possibly be when it lands in your hands.[/p][p]The past months have been a whirlwind of development, showcases, and feedback from players who tried the demo, and now with Dink on board, we’re more confident than ever about delivering something truly special.[/p][p]We’ll be sharing more updates, sneak peeks, and behind-the-scenes insights as we sprint toward release. As always, your feedback and wishlists mean the world to us; they make a real difference in helping Vextorial reach more players!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087239/b53f5aab401aa6790e774413a695f25d5362bff3.gif"][/img][/p][p]If you haven’t already, check out our updated Steam store page! Don’t forget to add Vextorial to your wishlist and share it with any friends who love puzzle adventures![/p][p]Thank you for being part of this journey, and stay tuned for more news soon![/p][p][b]– The Vext Games Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Vextorial Demo Speedrun Challenge is Ending!
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087239/6c2dacc982e267d406ae101ddac7d78ee9689bce.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087239/d187be11e70f34d08c613cedcc84113f5aab1440.jpg[/img][/url]

Just one week left until the Vextorial speedrun challenge ends! ⏰

Think you can dimension-hop at lightning speed? To celebrate the Vextorial Steam demo, we’ve launched a speedrun challenge to test your skills! The player who secures 1st place in each category will be awarded [u][b]a Steam Key for the full game[/b][/u] upon its official release!

⌛ Deadline: All speedrun submissions must be completed and uploaded by 23:59 (British Summer Time) on May 2nd, 2025.

Show us what you've got! Join our Discord Server for details: [url=http://discord.gg/A7kyzCDnJF ]http://discord.gg/A7kyzCDnJF [/url]
